_meta.notes: FORM FAMILY vs OFFICE - the cover is titled '2014 Financial Disclosure Report For County and Local School Board Candidates [County Officeholders - Year-End]'. That is a FORM FAMILY, not the office: the Office Sought line inside the form reads 'Mayor', so this is a county Mayor filing and IS in scope (checked explicitly against AGENT_BRIEF section 2). form_year records the printed title verbatim. / AMENDMENT - the chunk-file flag is CONFIRMED and is a real contradiction inside the form: the signature Date field is typed 'August 24, 2015 (Amended Report)' and the Summary Page and both attachment headers are stamped '8/24/15 (amended)' / '8/24/15 Amended', yet NEITHER the 'Yes' nor the 'No' amendment box is checked. is_amendment is therefore honestly '' with the filer's own word 'Amended' recorded in report_date; amendment_of is blank because the form names no prior report date. / The form is a 2014 YEAR-END report signed 2015-08-24 and clerk-stamped RECEIVED OCT 06 2015 - the report period, the signature date and the receipt date are three different years' worth apart and all three are on the page. / COLUMN B header on this vintage's Summary Page reads 'Year to Date' (not 'Aggregate Total'). This is still the STANDARD Summary Page - the page is titled 'Summary Page' and says 'Complete this page after filling out Itemized Contributions Received and Itemized Expenditures Made' - NOT the separate 'Summary Page Other Campaign Accounts' table. Column B equals Column A on both lines. / SHAPE - both sides are attachment-behind-stub: the county's own Schedule A (p3) and Schedule B (p7) pages are present with 'See attached spreadsheet' typed in row 1 and every other cell, including SUBTOTAL and TOTAL, blank; the filer's own typed spreadsheets on pp.4-6 and pp.8-10 carry all the lines. / OCCUPATION AND EMPLOYER ARE TWO SEPARATE COLUMNS on the contributions attachment (the county grid has one 'Occupation AND Employer' cell). Each row therefore carries 'occupation' = the Occupation cell verbatim AND an added 'employer' field = the Employer cell verbatim. Neither is ever inferred from the donor's name and neither is carried down from the row above. A blank in either is the filer leaving the cell empty (the columns exist) and every such row says so in its note. / PRIVACY - the contributions attachment prints Address / City / State / Zip columns and the county's black bar covers ALL FOUR on every page, so donor_city and donor_state are blank with 'redacted at source' in each row note; nothing was backfilled. Separately, the COVER of this filing is NOT redacted and prints the candidate's own home street address, city, state and ZIP in the clear - a finding about slco.org's redaction, recorded here without reproducing any of it. The expenditures attachment has no address column at all. / One donor name is TRUNCATED BY THE REDACTION BAR on p4 (contribution row 46) and is the only needs_review row in the filing; the same organization prints in full on p6 (row 134) and that full reading was deliberately NOT copied into row 46. / Filer spellings kept verbatim throughout ('Love Communciations', 'Garbett Managment', 'Kaye Whtie', 'Back Diamond', 'Western Revewable Technologies', and 'Frist Bank' three times on the expenditure sheet; the same donor's employer is typed 'reirted' on one row and 'reitred' on another). / Two expenditure rows are dated 1/16/2015 (refunds of over-cap contributions) on a 2014 year-end report - the filer's own dates, kept verbatim and never re-dated. Twelve contribution dates print a two-digit year (05/01/14, 12/05/14, 12/09/14 x2, 12/19/14); the year IS printed, so they parse, and each says so in its note. / No in-kind marker anywhere in the filing: neither attachment has an in-kind column and the filer wrote no label, asterisk or legend, so in_kind is false on all 278 rows. No '$50.00-and-under' aggregate row and no printed specimen row is present. / FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN passed on both sides: every date cell holds date-shaped content, every name cell name-shaped content, and on each page the count of names equals the count of amounts. One row (Kevin S. Garn, 04/30/2014) has what look like transposed Occupation/Employer values on the page; it is transcribed column-faithfully and flagged in its row note rather than corrected.

contributions.detail: 156 rows over pp.4-6 sum to 274232.00 to the cent = the attachment's own printed grand total at the foot of p6 ($274,232.00) = Summary line 1 Column A = Summary line 1 Column B = Summary line 4. Four printed figures agree with the row sum. No schedule-total-vs-summary-gap here and no in-kind rows anywhere in the attachment (the sheet has no in-kind column and the filer wrote no in-kind marker).

expenditures.detail: 122 rows over pp.8-10 sum to 180904.12 to the cent = the attachment's own printed grand total at the foot of p10 ($180,904.12) = Summary line 2 Column A = Column B = Summary line 6.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: NO per-page subtotal exists on either attachment, and the county's own Schedule A (p3) and Schedule B (p7) stubs say 'See attached spreadsheet' with their SUBTOTAL and TOTAL cells left blank - so the page-subtotal gate is unavailable on this filing. Gated instead on each attachment's printed GRAND TOTAL (p6 contributions, p10 expenditures), both of which the row sums match exactly. Per-page row sums for the record: p4 104,455.00 + p5 99,527.00 + p6 70,250.00 = 274,232.00; p8 92,229.37 + p9 55,595.47 + p10 33,079.28 = 180,904.12.
itemized.escalation_note: p4 the wrapped 'Laborers' Local Union No. 295, Politic...' donor cell at 1200 dpi (truncation confirmed, not a legibility problem); p6 the same donor's cell at 1200 dpi (prints in full there); p8 rows 1-10 as a 700 dpi band (read identically, rows marked verified); p10 rows 116-122 plus the printed grand total as a 700 dpi band (read identically, rows marked verified).
